note: Submodule of form_mode_manager. Registers a theme negotiator (theme.negotiator.form_mode_theme_switcher, priority -30) that applies on Form Mode Manager routes and picks a theme per form mode. Config object form_mode_manager_theme_switcher.settings: type.<form_mode_id> (admin | system-theme-key | _custom) and form_mode.<form_mode_id> (specific theme name when _custom). <form_mode_id> = the route _entity_form op with dots->underscores, e.g. node.contributor -> node_contributor. Configure route form_mode_manager.theme_switcher_settings (/admin/config/content/form_mode_manager/theme-switcher). Medium/hard cases are grounded on this config. Baseline for this submodule is empty config (no config/install ships), so cleanup/reset clear type/form_mode to empty.

evals.prompt: What does the form_mode_manager_theme_switcher module let me do, and where do I configure it?
evals.expected_output: It assigns a specific theme (admin, a system theme, or a named custom theme) to each Form Mode Manager form-mode route via a theme negotiator. Configure it at /admin/config/content/form_mode_manager/theme-switcher.

evals.prompt: Which config object and keys does form_mode_manager_theme_switcher use to store the theme chosen for a form mode, and how is the form-mode key derived?
evals.expected_output: Config object form_mode_manager_theme_switcher.settings with type.<form_mode_id> (admin | system theme key | _custom) and form_mode.<form_mode_id> (specific theme when _custom). <form_mode_id> is the _entity_form operation with dots replaced by underscores (e.g. node.contributor -> node_contributor).

evals.prompt: Does form_mode_manager_theme_switcher change the theme on all routes? When does its theme negotiator apply?
evals.expected_output: No — the negotiator (theme.negotiator.form_mode_theme_switcher) only applies on routes generated by Form Mode Manager (routes carrying the _form_mode_manager_entity_type_id option) that have a configured type or a form_mode_theme route option.

evals.prompt: On this site, form_mode_manager_theme_switcher has been configured for the node 'contributor' form mode. Inspect the live configuration and state which theme type is set for it.
evals.expected_output: type.node_contributor = admin (the contributor form-mode forms use the admin theme).

evals.prompt: The node 'editor' form mode on this site is configured with form_mode_manager_theme_switcher to use a specific custom theme. Inspect the live configuration and name that theme.
Using form_mode_manager_theme_switcher, configure the node 'contributor' form mode so its add/edit forms render in the site's admin theme. Apply the change to the live site.
Using form_mode_manager_theme_switcher, make the node 'reviewer' form mode use the specific theme 'claro' (a named custom theme, not the admin/front default). Apply the change to the live site.
